newsitem.title: CANADA: Siberian tiger roams loose in Ontario town.
newsitem.headline: Siberian tiger roams loose in Ontario town.

text.p: An escaped Siberian tiger was roaming the streets of Barrie, Ontario, on Sunday and police were warning people to stay indoors until the 800 pound (360 kilogram) beast was rounded up.
The tiger escaped from an unidentified location around 1200 EST (1700 GMT) and was still at large a few hours later.

Ontario Provincial Police did not have any further details and refused to say from where the animal escaped, saying only that it came from a township about one mile (1.6 km) west of Barrie City Limits. Barrie is about 56 miles (90 kilometres) north of Toronto.
